question: Test sector-resolved half-stock stops and holding before matching transfer.

objects.definition: record minus residual stock, normalized by positive initial sector stock
objects.domain: individual closed sector state with positive initial stock

sources.section_or_object_id: signed stock crossing and error bracket

assumptions: Positive constant sector rates, orthogonal source and record decompositions, zero initial records.
Persistent sector completion bits; disable both directions after the first transversal half-stock event. Zero initial sector stock is complete by convention.
Exact isolation during wait. Complete matching swap assumed for exact terminal result.

technique_plan.technique: closed skew blocks and rational stock replay
technique_plan.purpose_or_na_reason: test event order, retention, and terminal response

integer_fraction_receipt.raw_count_expression: one half direct plus one half full even swap

clock_receipt.update_rule: first upward sector crossing disables its block
clock_receipt.period_claim: local first half phase pi/4; joint handoff is readiness only

dynamics_readout.state_space: E and T2 source and record blocks plus matching record and two completion bits
dynamics_readout.generator_or_update: skew exchange on active sectors, zero on held sectors
dynamics_readout.conservation_and_sources: metric stock preserved within blocks and across identity switches
dynamics_readout.projection_and_kernel: matching swap accesses only retained even sector

fitted_parameters_or_formula_choices: sector-specific latches and readiness guard declared
target_exposure.search_domain_and_budget: exact ideal switch and conditional error budget; no empirical fit
target_exposure.selection_criterion: exact half-stock retention followed by equal terminal shear gains

calculation_steps: Prove hold under zeroed block and conservative switch
Bound detector error and incomplete swap

result.exact_expression: t_k=pi/(4 omega_k); direct gains (1/2,1/2); final gains (1,1/2)
result.scope: Independent upward crossings with two-direction isolation retain half stocks until joint readiness; a full subsequent matching swap yields equal shear weights 1/2.

counterexamples_and_failures: Recording completion without isolation leaves the fast oscillator running
limitations: No sourced sector latch, hold, or Stage 2 trigger
No measured clock or deficit allocation
next_discriminant: Test whether admitted local receipts can supply persistent sector-resolved completion, hold isolation and joint handoff.
